diagnostics.title: SetFlag without matching WaitFlag
diagnostics.message: 2 SetFlag<MTE1_MTE2>(EVENT_ID0) outside any loop but only 1 matching WaitFlag; the extra priming flags are never drained, leaking hardware event slots
diagnostics.remediation: Add 1 draining AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::MTE1_MTE2>(EVENT_ID0); after the loop, matching the priming SetFlag calls before it.

diagnostics.remediation: Add 1 draining AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::MTE1_MTE2>(EVENT_ID1); after the loop, matching the priming SetFlag calls before it.

diagnostics.remediation: Add 1 draining AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::M_MTE1>(EVENT_ID1); after the loop, matching the priming SetFlag calls before it.

diagnostics.title: Fragmented SRAM layout
diagnostics.message: L1 layout leaves 1504 B (58%) unclaimed below the high-water mark of 2592 B
diagnostics.remediation: Compact the layout so tiles are contiguous; the reclaimed 1504 B would allow a larger tile and fewer loop iterations.
